prompt: I'm the lead developer for a startup building a data analytics platform. We've got this Python service that processes customer metrics data - it's basically the heart of our real-time dashboard. Problem is, it's getting hammered by requests and response times are going to hell. I need you to profile this thing, figure out where the bottlenecks are, then optimize the crap out of it. The service needs to handle at least 1000 requests per second with sub-100ms response times. Also need a proper benchmark report showing before/after performance so I can present it to the CTO. The main endpoint is /api/metrics and it does some heavy data aggregation. Can you make this thing fly?
